name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Raging Bolt ex)

releases.name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Raging Bolt ex)

description.text: The Master Strategy Deck Building Set (大师战略卡组构筑套装) Raging Bolt ex is a box for players who want to start battling quickly and keep improving a deck, one of three released on 16 July 2026 with the Raging Bolt ex, Dragapult ex and Gholdengo ex decks, following the first three of January 2026. It holds a ready-built 60-card Raging Bolt ex deck, with Raging Bolt ex, Teal Mask Ogerpon ex and Fezandipiti ex among its Pokémon, Earthen Vessel, Night Stretcher and Crispin among its Trainers, and the ACE SPEC Prime Catcher. Pokémon China pitched it at players who enjoy sharp attacks and quick wins. With it come a sheet on how the deck plays, a 15-card modification pack and a guide to changing the deck, four 20-card Chasing Glory (共逐荣光) packs to change it further, with all kinds of Trainer's Pokémon, a set of 64 card sleeves in one of eight designs at random, a Raging Bolt deck box with two dividers, a coin die, six metal damage-counter dice and Poison and Burn markers. Its cards are numbered out of 31.

sources.title: Pokémon China: The new Master Strategy Deck Building Sets: Raging Bolt ex, Dragapult ex and Gholdengo ex (29 June 2026)
